Bajaj Pulsar Motorcycles Undergo Updates, Spy Shots Reveal New Features

Spy shots have emerged of updated versions of the Bajaj Pulsar NS200 and N250 motorcycles, indicating potential new features. The images suggest the inclusion of WP USD (Upside Down) forks and a TFT display, signaling advancements in suspension and technology for these models. The Bajaj Pulsar 150 is also noted for its evolution, blending nostalgic elements with modern performance as the company develops a new generation of its mass-performance Pulsar line.
